# derive-state-from-one-clock

**Claim.** Make time-dependent state a pure function of one authoritative clock, never an accumulation of per-tick deltas, and treat every time value the platform reports as a claim to bound.

**Not when.** Path-dependent simulation · Genuinely interactive state · When evaluating at an arbitrary instant is too expensive · Values whose semantics you control and have verified on the target · The viewport is an input to drawing, not to state

**Check.** reach the same instant from the start and from the end and compare the output byte for byte; every reported interval has a clamp and every inferred intent its own call

*measured.* Open the full note only when you cannot tell whether its boundary holds here: [derive-state-from-one-clock](../notes/active/derive-state-from-one-clock.md).
